name: Growing coin row
oneLiner: solid 3D metal coins (bronze, silver, gold) spin in one after another, each bigger than the last, climbing a slow staircase while the camera pulls back in log space; the last gold coin lands with a glint across its face and a ring of light
say: when the speaker counts money up in steps ('first a dollar, then ten, then a hundred, then a thousand'): cut in on the first amount, each coin lands on its number, the gold one on the last
